engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Solenoid Valve 5 (N92) Open or Şasiye Kısa Devre
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Solenoid Valve 5 (N92)

Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Solenoid Valve 5 (N92)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
Gerçekleştirin: Output Test
technicalNotes:
In some vehicles, (N92) may be refereed to as (N216) in the factory repair manual.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the following 6-Speed Automatic Transmission (09G) equipped NAR (North American Market) vehicles, perhaps in conjunction with P0798, a flash update may be required:
2012 2.5L VW Jetta Sedan, JSW (Jetta Sportwagon), Golf, Beetle and Passat
2012 VW CC 3.6L
2012 VW Tiguan 2.0T
See TSB 01-12-34 -or- TPI 2029268 for details.
